phase: Eight development fact-following cases x three prompts x two seeds = 48 calls. Four prior stress cases and four newly constructed development cases. Not an unseen confirmation.
primary: Every case must satisfy schedule and explicit fact constraints; all final responses are manually reviewed for unsupported factual claims. New choices are allowed. No desired consumption direction, medical-visit ban, spending target, or external policy result is imposed.
sampling_rationale: Presence penalty zero is a new shared development setting to permit faithful repeated terminology. This run compares prompts at the same setting; changes from v8/v9 cannot be attributed to prompt alone.
selection: Require all constraints and factual grounding across both seeds before a larger development screen. Then compare total generated tokens. Preserve all raw attempts; no hidden repair or retry.
prohibitions: No P010 modification; no P015 rerun; no promotion from format success alone. Unused 24-person confirmation remains sealed.
